steps.title: Configure App Metadata
steps.description: Establish the application package name and metadata for build-pipeline mapping.

steps.title: Establish Schema Configurations
steps.description: Define the app configuration to operate completely offline without server-side integrations.

steps.title: Define Gradle Configuration
steps.description: Configure build parameters to target SDK 34 and setup JDK 17 environments for smooth compilation.

steps.title: Develop Android Manifest
steps.description: Establish launch flow and standard hardware configuration flags inside AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Create SQLite Database Layer
steps.description: Implement local database schema with optimized relational structured tables for product stock, sales ledger, customer metrics, purchases, expenses and app global configuration settings.

steps.title: Construct Dashboard Interface XML
steps.description: Implement grid layouts to render business indicators including net profit, daily sales, low stock alerts, and quick action launch pads.

steps.title: Build Main Dashboard Controller
steps.description: Setup business data bindings and register trigger actions to dynamically render business metrics.

steps.title: Create Product Management Layouts
steps.description: Assemble interfaces for product searching, inventory listing, addition, deletion, and low stock visualization indicators.

steps.title: Develop Product Operations Logic
steps.description: Construct handlers for searching items, processing barcode categories, minimum threshold logic, and inventory logging.

steps.title: Design Customer Record Layouts
steps.description: Build layout files for managing contacts, transaction totals, outstanding balances, and list presentation panels.

steps.title: Develop Customer Record Handlers
steps.description: Implement validation and database binding for processing user logs and updating outstanding credit balances.

steps.title: Construct Advanced Sales Checkout Layout
steps.description: Assemble advanced transaction layout enabling multi-item selection, real-time discount calculations, tax rules, and payments balance management.

steps.title: Develop Interactive Sales Checkout Logic
steps.description: Implement interactive checkout handling. Formulates multi-product list, deducts item stock automatically, creates invoice data, and updates customer outstanding balances.

steps.title: Assemble Purchase & Expense UI and Logic
steps.description: Construct inventory replenishment handlers, supplier detail management, and daily operational expense logging features.

steps.title: Develop Low Stock alerts and System Settings Screen
steps.description: Build configuration screens with options to set global metrics, tax policies, reset databases, and pre-load complex sample data sets.

steps.title: Develop Business Reports View
steps.description: Design a statistics and analytical reporting panel representing complete sale metrics, purchasing overheads, and computed gross margins.

steps.title: Build Shareable Digital Invoice View
steps.description: Create an invoice billing interface supporting native digital sharing parameters and detailed cost line-item tables.

steps.title: Building DailyBiz Manager
steps.description: Perform code linting, layout compilation and final offline validation tests.
